definitions.candidatePool: all distinct movieIds observed in train, including zero-positive-degree movies
definitions.valCandidates: C minus all train-rated movies for this user
definitions.testCandidates: C minus all train- or validation-rated movies for this user
definitions.relevant: rating >= 4 in this evaluation split AND movie in that user candidate set
definitions.sharedCohort: train user AND positive train edge AND verified selected-MF finite scoring of every required candidate AND at least one eligible relevant
definitions.aggregation: macro mean of per-user hits / eligible relevant count; not pooled; not calculated at stage 2
definitions.split: per-user timestamp ASC, movieId ASC on ties; floor(.8*n), floor(.1*n), remainder; <5 excluded explicitly
definitions.candidateReconstruction: candidateIds minus perUser.excludedSeenIds; same helper and masks for all methods
definitions.mfPending: sharedCohort=null is unknown, NOT empty/zero Recall; preMfCohort is explicitly provisional

mfProvenance.scoring: clip(mu + dot(P[rawUserId],Q[rawMovieId]),1,5); exact ties by raw movieId ASC
